## __A simple but cartoonishly violent visual enhancement mod!__

Adds blood effects, ground decals, datadriven blood types and config, and a graphic content client config! ![](https://c10.patreonusercontent.com/4/patreon-media/p/post/161459527/87b6c1fe155541de855e6d3a863356da/eyJhIjoxLCJwIjoxfQ==/1.gif?token-hash=Nw9uFI-yyyBGB_h7VYR7D_f7mLRQx70-9KOsgfJb6uI=&token-time=1781913600)

## __Compatibilty__

Submit requests for [modded entity compat here!](https://github.com/iron431/simple-blood-mod/issues)  
Blood emission compat with:
*   Vanilla
*   Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
*   Guard Villagers
*   Born in Chaos
*   Ice and Fire
*   The Aether

## __Disclaimer__

This mod also offers a "graphic content" client config to turn off blood effects marked as graphic.
